title: Capture audit
prompt: Implement `static int TotalCaptured()` that: creates 10 closures over a shared counter local (all 10 increment the SAME captured int), invokes each once, and returns the counter's final value. Also implement `static int TotalDistinct()` doing the same but with 10 closures each capturing their OWN copy; invoke each once and return the sum of the 10 copies (each 1) = 10.

tests.name: shared-vs-distinct
tests.code:
Cj.Eq(Solution.TotalCaptured(), 10, "shared capture accumulates");
Cj.Eq(Solution.TotalDistinct(), 10, "distinct copies sum");
tests.hint: Shared: one display-class field incremented 10 times → 10. Distinct: 10 copies, each incremented once → sum 10.
